COS V P P SPQR OPTIMO PRINC

An incomplete Roman silver denarius of Trajan (AD 98 - 117), perhaps 'Provinces' reverse depicting Arabia standing left holding branch and cinnamon sticks or incense; at her feet a camel walking left. Around is the inscription COS V P P SPQR OPTIMO PRINC. Mint of Rome, AD 103-11 (Reece period 5). Reference: RIC volume II, p.253, no.142
